The '''1929 [[La Liga|Primera División]] season''' was the inaugural season of the Primera División. It started on 10 February 1929 and finished on 23 June 1929. A total of 10 teams participated in the league.

After the failure to create a national league in 1928, that ended with the teams split into two unconcluded leagues, an agreement with the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation]] was finally reached for the creation of a national league.

[[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] won the title after beating [[Real Unión]] in the last round and taking advantage of the loss of [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] at [[Athletic Bilbao]]. Therefore, the Catalans were proclaimed the inaugural champions.

== Election of teams ==
After months of discussion, on 23 November 1928 the creation of a championship divided in divisions was finalized.{{Citation needed|date=November 2020}}

The first division would be joined by the six teams that won any time the [[Copa del Rey|Spanish Championship]] ([[Arenas Club de Getxo|Arenas]], [[Athletic Bilbao]], [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]], [[Real Sociedad]] and [[Real Unión]]) and three teams that qualified for at least one final ([[Atlético Madrid|Athletic Madrid]], [[RCD Espanyol|Español]] and [[CE Europa|Europa]]).{{citation needed|date=April 2018}}

The tenth place would be decided in a tournament where only the winner would join La Liga, while the rest of the participant teams played the [[1929 Segunda División|Segunda División]] with [[Racing de Madrid|Racing Madrid]].

=== Qualifying tournament ===
[[Racing de Santander|Racing Santander]] achieved the last place in the inaugural season of La Liga after beating [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] in the second tie-break match.

== Relegation play-off ==
Last placed team [[Racing de Santander|Racing Santander]] faced [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]], winner of the [[1929 Segunda División]], in a two-legged play-off. Racing won 3–2 on aggregate, thus remaining in La Liga.
